correctness.rationale: For d=m+n>=3, actual Pilaud–Poliakova z_J=binom(u+1,2)+b and affine sum binom(d+1,2) imply 2L_J=s(d-s)+b(s+u-1); the projected subset normal has squared length s(d-s)/d. This gives the exact stated shell equation and nonnegative penalty. Since s(d-s)>=d-1 and each singleton has z=1, every ball has radius <=sqrt(d(d-1))/2 by summing coordinate constraints, with equality forcing the uniform center. Equality of tight shell distances holds precisely at s=1 or (s=d-1,b=0). Inspected rational script was reconstructed and executed independently: 63,924 exact subset checks for 2<=m<=7,1<=n<=7; the proof, not the finite test, establishes all m>=2,n>=1.
